decisions.reason: Uses Junction, Target, and link marker evidence to establish the profile entry is the repo working tree, so repo edits already update the installed copy.
Relates copy failures and stale behavior to the running DSH host owning loaded files/state, separates browser cache from locks, and requires host restart plus cache-bypassing refresh.
Explains rename-aside through the junction renamed the only source files and caused copy source-not-found, then restores .old2 files and verifies syntax before activation.
Gives the correct post-edit order: stop host, no copy, restart dsh web, hard-refresh, and verify host/client behavior and load health.
Requires inspecting LinkType/Target and the link marker before file operations and explains why generic copy-into-node_modules advice caused the incident.

caps.reason: The recovery plan renames .old2 files back and rejects copying through the junction.
The plan requires a full host stop/restart and hard refresh, not browser closure or refresh alone.
